items.title: Je n’en puis plus durer (Passereau)
items.desc: Pierre Passereau, Je n’en puis plus durer, 1540. 4 voices (Superius, Contratenor, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), at the original pitch; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
